description: NVDB - Cykelföreteelser is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo-netinfo.trafikverket.se. Bicycle-specific data from the National Road Database (NVDB): CRekbilvagbiketrafik Speed obstacle GCM separation GCM Passage GCM illuminated GCM road type Tourism bike trail (replacing CCykelled) Available on state cycle paths and on municipal cycle paths in about 150 municipalities. Not complete. Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "NVDB - Cycling" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
